findings.description: dismissDispute is allowed while the booking is still unsettled (resolveDispute's UNSETTLED_STATUSES 409 is deliberately not applied to dismissal), so it can overlap the transaction that completes the booking (parent confirmCompletion, the quick-complete timeout, or a force-complete). That completing transaction's BEFORE_COMMIT enqueuePayout reads existsOpenDisputeForBooking, still sees the OPEN dispute (the dismiss is uncommitted under READ COMMITTED), and inserts the coach_payouts row as FROZEN with dispute_frozen = true; meanwhile the dismiss's clearDisputeFreeze calls findByIdForUpdate on coach_payouts before the insert commits, finds no row, and no-ops. The two transactions share no lock (the completion only reads the disputes table; the dismiss only updates its own dispute row), so both commit, leaving a DISMISSED dispute and a payout frozen for it with no code path that ever clears the flag — the coach is never paid without operator intervention.
findings.title: dismissDispute racing a completion's payout enqueue leaves the payout permanently FROZEN for a closed dispute
findings.verification: Confirm no scheduled job clears dispute_frozen by re-checking the disputes table: CoachPayoutRepository's comment says StalePayoutAlertScheduler only alerts on payouts stuck in FROZEN/HOLD, it does not release them. Also confirm existsOpenDisputeForBooking is a plain native read (CoachPayoutRepository.java:246-250) with no lock on the dispute row.

findings.description: For a pack-funded booking, paidForSession derives sessionPrice from CoachPayoutRepository.findGrossAmountByBookingId, which selects the live grossAmount column — the value CoachPayoutAdjustmentService.cutNet reduces when a first dispute's PARTIAL_CREDIT is applied to a not-yet-released payout. If a second dispute is later raised on the same booking (allowed once the first is RESOLVED) and resolved with a credit, sessionPrice is the cut gross rather than the original: remainingRefundable caps the parent's credit at cutGross minus prior credits (under-crediting the parent), and reconcileCoachPayout passes the cut gross as parentPrice to applyRefund, so coachShareOfRefund computes originalNet * credited / cutGross — an inflated denominator-shrunk share that over-cuts or over-reverses the coach. The per-dispute amounts no longer reconcile against what was actually paid for the session.
findings.title: Second dispute on a pack-funded booking prices the session from the already-cut payout gross
findings.verification: Confirm findGrossAmountByBookingId (CoachPayoutRepository.java:73-74) selects p.grossAmount rather than p.originalGrossAmount, and that CoachPayoutAdjustmentService.cutNet reduces grossAmount on a pending payout while CoachPayout.originalGrossAmount keeps the first-computed value.
